title: Understanding Your Credit Card Rewards Categories
summary: Explains how Rho-Bank credit card rewards categories work: every card earns a base reward on all purchases, with higher-rate bonus categories that vary by card. Lists available categories (Travel, Dining, Groceries, Entertainment, Shopping, Utilities, Transportation, Software, Media, Green/Sustainable, Operations) and how to find your card’s specific rates via the mobile app/website or terms.
faqs: Do all Rho-Bank credit cards earn rewards on every purchase?
